title: ARM-Choosing an opponent
description: A mod with customizable particle effects that adds beautiful visual effects when attacking creatures. Supports animated rings, spirals, and special effects. Full configuration via GUI or commands. It works even when the particle quality is turned off.
body:
_**"ARM Mod"**_ — Choosing an Opponent
The mod simplifies PvP battles in Minecraft: it visually highlights current opponents using customizable particles.

Main features
Visual indication of opponents: Active opponents are marked with spectacular particles during combat.

```
Flexible adjustment of effects:
number of particles;
height and radius of the effect;
animation speed;
number of target opponents;
particle type (multiple options to choose from).
```

**Convenient configuration:**
through the graphical menu (opens with the J key);
using commands (/curpvp).

**How to use:**
- To open the settings menu, press the J key.
- Customize effects — change the particle parameters to suit your game style.
- Apply settings — changes are saved automatically.

The mod helps you navigate faster in combat, clearly identifying current opponents even in chaotic battles.
